**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

- **§ 11.1 (p0096):** automatic renewal in successive **one (1) year** terms, terminable by either party on **30 days'** written notice before the end of the initial or any renewal term. Notice window 30 days ≤ fallback 60 (and ≤ preferred 30); renewal term 12 months, so no automatic multi-year renewal and no >90-day window (walk-away not engaged).
- **Price uplift:** none. Exhibit B (p0153–p0154) fixes MarketSite.net and Maintenance/Support fees for "Year 2-5, and beyond", and § 4.2 (p0055) continues maintenance at the Exhibit B fees. The conditional price-increase cap element is not triggered.
- **Noted, not redlined:** no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal — a minor preferred-only sub-element; we can request it if a renewal reminder becomes commercially important.

No redline proposed.
